input.question: Which 10 artists have the most tracks?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 10

input.question: What were the monthly sales in 2013?
input.evidence: sales = SUM(Invoice.Total) rounded to cents; month = strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate)

expect.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS sales FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2013-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
